page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c1.small is an x86_64 architecture server instance belonging to the ecs.c1 family, virtualized via the KVM hypervisor. It features 8 dedicated physical cores and 8 vCPUs operating with a thread-per-core ratio of 1.0, indicating that hyperthreading is disabled. The instance is equipped with 8.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of 1.0 GB of RAM per core.

This server type does not include local storage or bundled GPUs, meaning all storage requirements must be met through network-attached options. Hardware-level instruction set extensions such as AVX, AVX-512, AMX, AES-NI, and FMA are not available on this instance. It also does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Given the dedicated CPU allocation and low memory-to-core ratio, the ecs.c1.small is structured for compute-bound workloads that require predictable CPU performance without high memory overhead. The lack of hyperthreading ensures dedicated execution resources per vCPU. This profile is suitable for parallel processing tasks, batch computing, and lightweight web serving workloads that do not require large in-memory datasets or advanced vector instructions.
